decision.explanation: The query asks for the profession of 'Andrew McFarlane'. The source documents describe three distinct individuals with this name: 1) Sir Andrew Ewart McFarlane (born 1954), identified as a British judge, Lord Justice of Appeal, President of the Family Division, Queen's Counsel, and Bencher (Sources D1S1-D1S6, D2S1); 2) Andrew McFarlane (1899–1972), identified as an Irish cricketer (Source D5S1); 3) Andrew McFarlane, identified as a renowned chef (Source D4S1). The 'research assistant' role (C7) refers to a 'Matthew W. McFarland' in Source D3, which is a different name and likely a different entity, so it is excluded. 'Right-handed batsman' describes a playing style, not the primary profession, though 'cricketer' is the profession. 'Family division president' is included as a specific professional title held by the judge. All accepted answers correspond to distinct valid referents found in the text.
